title: 第14章 什么？你还杀了人？
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

念念吃完饭。

踮着脚在水池里把餐盘冲干净，这才放到回收台上。

“阿姨辛苦了！”

“不辛苦不辛苦！念念有空多来玩啊！阿姨给你留好吃的！”

“嗯嗯！”

念念快乐跑远。

还没跑出食堂，就在食堂门口撞上一个人。

念念被反弹，一屁股坐在地上。

摔得有些懵。

(꒪⌓꒪)

任局长赶紧蹲下：“小朋友，你没事吧？要不要伯伯带你去医院？”

念念原本是不痛的。

这摔得还没她以前和人打架痛。

但这几天李安国对她的照顾无微不至，心里觉得自己也是有靠山的娃了。

任局长这么一问，念念心里的委屈就蹭的一下升起。

“哇——”

“小朋友你别哭啊！你是哪里痛？伯伯先抱你起来好不好？”

“不要不要不要！我要爸爸！我要爸爸！”

念念一哭就停不下来。

声音越来越大，将食堂人的目光都吸引了过来。

任局长急得抓耳挠腮。

不停在身上翻找。

想看看有没有糖或者玩具，能哄一哄这个小孩。

结果这一摸。

任宏义哭了！

“哇——”

哭声比念念还大。

“完了完了，我把我老婆的照片给弄丢了！

老婆我对不起你！！”

念念被吓了一跳。

连忙从地上站起。

脸上还挂着泪珠呢，手就搭在任宏义的肩膀拍打，“伯伯你别哭了，我没事。”

结果任宏义的哭声更大了！

幸好食堂现在没什么人，只有几名打扫的职工。

听见哭声，几人匆匆赶来查看。

询问情况后。

脸色不一。

“任局长别哭了，万一是你今天没带呢？”

说这话的人有些心虚。

谁不知道任局长每天贴身带着那张照片，时不时就要拿出来看一眼。

好在很快有人接了他的话。

“任局长别急，或许是你失手放在哪忘记了，想想你去过的地方，我们帮你找！”

“对！对！肯定是我放失手了，我现在就去找！”

任宏义宛若抓到救命稻草，起身就往外面跑。

念念也紧跟其后，举着小手道：“我也来帮忙！”

【咦，怎么这个时间点，这节目还开播呢？这是在干嘛？】

Page (1/3)

Nian Nian finished her meal.

He stood on tiptoes and rinsed the dishes in the sink before placing them on the recycling table.

"Thank you for your hard work, aunt!"

"It's not hard, it's not hard! Come and play more when Niannian has time! Auntie will leave some delicious food for you!"

"Yeah!"

Run away happily.

Before I ran out of the canteen, I bumped into someone at the door of the canteen.

Niannian was bounced back and sat down on the ground.

I fell a little confused.

(꒪⌓꒪)

Director Ren quickly squatted down: "Kid, are you okay? Do you want uncle to take you to the hospital?"

Nian Nian originally didn't hurt.

This fall was not as painful as her previous fights with others.

But in the past few days, Li Anguo had taken great care of her, and he felt that he had a supporter.

Director Ren asked this question, and the grievance in Nian Nian's heart suddenly rose.

"Wow——"

"Kid, don't cry! Where do you feel the pain? Can uncle hug you first?"

"No, no, no! I want daddy! I want daddy!"

Nian Nian couldn't stop crying.

The sound became louder and louder, attracting the attention of everyone in the cafeteria.

Director Ren was so anxious that he scratched his head and ears.

Keep rummaging around on your body.

I wanted to see if there was any candy or toys that could comfort the child.

The result is this touch.

Ren Hongyi cried!

"Wow——"

The crying was louder than Nian Nian.

“It’s over, it’s over, I lost my wife’s photo!

Wife, I'm sorry for you!!"

Niannian was startled.

He quickly stood up from the ground.

With tears still hanging on his face, he put his hand on Ren Hongyi's shoulder and patted him, "Uncle, please stop crying, I'm fine."

As a result, Ren Hongyi cried even louder!

Fortunately, there is no one in the cafeteria now, except for a few cleaning staff.

Hearing the cry, several people hurried over to check.

After asking about the situation.

There are different expressions on the faces.

"Director Ren, don't cry. What if you didn't bring it with you today?"

The person who said this felt guilty.

Who doesn't know that Director Ren carries that photo close to his body every day and takes it out to look at from time to time.

Fortunately, someone quickly answered him.

"Don't worry, Director Ren. Maybe you forgot where you left it. Think about where you have been and we will help you find it!"

"Yes! Yes! I must have let it go. I'm going to look for it now!"

As if grasping a life-saving straw, Ren Hongyi got up and ran outside.

Nian Nian followed closely, raising her little hands and saying, "I'm here to help too!"
